docs.title: Open Cataclysmic Variable Radio Catalog (OCVRC)
docs.text:
OCVRC is a Python pipeline for building a multi-survey astronomical database from a user-supplied list of sky coordinates. It combines SIMBAD source identification, VLASS and RACS image-based radio measurements, ancillary survey catalog measurements and SQLite export.

The Catalog Fields page documents the complete final database schema.

The pipeline is a general-purpose builder derived from the OCVRC research project. Its outputs depend on the supplied sources and on external-service availability.

Getting started · Input catalog · Catalog Fields

docs.title: Building a catalog
docs.text:
Run python Run_OCVRC.py from the repository root. The master runner calls: source ingestion; VLASS/RACS image retrieval; neighbor detection; GLS radio PSF fitting; radio table assembly; Gaia, 2MASS, GALEX, LoTSS, ROSAT, XMM, Chandra and eROSITA integrations; final five-table assembly; SQLite creation; and optional validation.

[PIPELINE] VALIDATION = TRUE runs the same validation suite after database creation. Source queries reuse completed checkpoints with [QUERY_MANAGEMENT] RESUME = TRUE. Failed service requests and genuine no-matches are tracked separately.

Outputs include output/final/OCVRC.db and five final pandas DataFrames. The SQLite builder can also run independently as python database/Build_SQLite_Database.py using existing final DataFrames.

The SQLite database includes all retained radio fit results, including negative fluxes and measurements flagged as affected by neighbors. Where VLASS tiles overlap, more than one measurement per source/epoch may appear.

docs.title: Configuration
docs.text:
All editable settings are in the root config.txt file, with uppercase keys. Relative paths resolve relative to the project root. Key sections:

Section Purpose [PATHS] Input file, output directory, VLASS image URL lists, RACS cache directory [SIMBAD] Matching radius, timeout and retry controls [PROCESSING] SKIP_SIMBAD (local testing only) [IMAGE_RETRIEVAL] Source row range and optional plotting [VLASS], [RACS] Radio cutout parameters and RACS cache access Survey sections Coordinate matching radius, query row ranges and retry settings [QUERY_MANAGEMENT] RESUME, SAVE_EVERY, CONSECUTIVE_FAILURE_LIMIT [PIPELINE] Stage switches, including VALIDATION = TRUE

Do not commit passwords or authentication tokens. Set CASDA_USERNAME in your local config.txt or use the CASDA_USERNAME environment variable as supported by the retrieval script. Before a full run, ensure START_ROW = 0 and END_ROW = -1 for stages where the options apply.

The repository ships both VLASS URL lists and precomputed VLASS/RACS GLS correlation files. These files must remain in their configured locations.

docs.title: Diagnostic plots
docs.text: Production suppresses optional image and neighbor-detection diagnostic figures by default. To enable them for investigation, set [DIAGNOSTICS] SHOW_PLOTS = TRUE and select an image using [IMAGE_RETRIEVAL] DISPLAY_INDEX in config.txt. Plot settings do not change the underlying measurements.

docs.title: Catalog Fields
docs.text:
This is the authoritative final SQLite schema implemented by database/Build_SQLite_Database.py and database/Build_Final_Database.py in this release. Table names and field names are exact.

The five tables are linked by SOURCE_ID. SQLite INTEGER flags encode True as 1, False as 0, and unknown/not-applicable values as NULL where supported.

docs.title: source_table
docs.text: Field SQLite type Units SQL NULL allowed Description SOURCE_ID INTEGER — No Primary key, identifies the source RA REAL degrees No Adopted right ascension (0 ≤ RA < 360) DEC REAL degrees No Adopted declination (−90 ≤ DEC ≤ 90) SIMBAD INTEGER 0/1 No Whether a SIMBAD positional match was found MAJOR_AXIS REAL mas Yes SIMBAD coordinate-uncertainty ellipse axis value, where available MINOR_AXIS REAL mas Yes SIMBAD coordinate-uncertainty ellipse axis value, where available POSITION_ANGLE REAL degrees Yes SIMBAD coordinate-uncertainty position angle DISTANCE REAL kpc Yes Distance estimated using Gaia parallax DISTANCE_ERROR REAL kpc Yes Uncertainty in Gaia-derived distance PM_RA REAL mas/yr Yes Gaia proper motion in RA, including cos(DEC) convention PM_DEC REAL mas/yr Yes Gaia proper motion in declination

docs.title: name_table
docs.text: Field SQLite type Units SQL NULL allowed Description SOURCE_ID INTEGER — No Foreign key to source_table NAME TEXT — No Source name or alias DEFAULT_NAME INTEGER 0/1 No Exactly one preferred name (1) per source

docs.title: class_table
docs.text: Field SQLite type Units SQL NULL allowed Description SOURCE_ID INTEGER — No Foreign key to source_table CLASS TEXT — No Source classification DEFAULT_CLASS INTEGER 0/1 No Exactly one preferred class for each classified source

docs.title: period_table
docs.text: Field SQLite type Units SQL NULL allowed Description SOURCE_ID INTEGER — No Foreign key to source_table TYPE TEXT — No Period type (Orbital or Spin) UNITS TEXT hours or seconds No Hours for orbital, seconds for spin PERIOD REAL as UNITS No User-provided period PERIOD_ERROR REAL as UNITS Yes User-provided period uncertainty CONFIRMED INTEGER 0/1/NULL Yes User-provided confirmation flag where available

docs.title: measurement_table
docs.text:
Field SQLite type Units SQL NULL allowed Description SOURCE_ID INTEGER — No Foreign key to source_table OBSERVATORY TEXT — Yes¹ Survey / observatory identifier EPOCH TEXT — Yes¹ Observation epoch or catalog release BAND TEXT varies Yes¹ Spectral, photometric or energy band UNITS TEXT varies Yes¹ Units of measured value and associated uncertainty MEASUREMENT REAL as UNITS Yes¹ Measured flux or catalog measurement; negative radio fits retained ERROR REAL as UNITS Yes¹ Symmetric uncertainty when supplied POS_ERROR REAL as UNITS Yes¹ Positive asymmetric uncertainty when supplied NEG_ERROR REAL as UNITS Yes¹ Negative asymmetric uncertainty when supplied NEIGHBOR INTEGER 0/1/NULL Yes Radio neighbor-contamination flag: 0 not flagged; 1 flagged; NULL not applicable

¹ The SQLite schema permits NULL in measurement columns, but the current validation suite imposes stricter completeness checks on processed measurement rows. An observation can use a symmetric ERROR or a pair of asymmetric POS_ERROR and NEG_ERROR values.

docs.title: Measurement interpretation
docs.text:
The OBSERVATORY, EPOCH, BAND and UNITS fields must be interpreted together; unlike fixed radio bands, ancillary surveys have survey-specific measurement units and bands. VLASS (VLA) radio measurements use 2-4 GHz and mJy; RACS (ASKAP) radio measurements use 887.5 MHz and mJy. NEIGHBOR applies to those two radio surveys, and is NULL for all other surveys.

Repeated VLASS records for the same source and epoch may arise when image tiles overlap. They are retained as distinct fits rather than silently deduplicated.

docs.title: Constraints
docs.text:
• SOURCE_ID is unique and non-NULL in source_table.
  • Each source has exactly one preferred NAME.
  • Each classified source has exactly one preferred CLASS; unclassified sources may have no class row.
  • The period table allows one row per (SOURCE_ID, TYPE).
  • The SQLite database includes foreign-key constraints and indexes for names, classes and measurements.

docs.title: Getting started
docs.text:
Install Python and the dependencies from the repository root:

python -m pip install -r requirements.txt

Inspect config.txt, especially [PATHS], [SIMBAD], [RACS] and [PIPELINE]. Replace the demonstration input/sources.csv with your own source coordinates. The default output location is output/.

Run the complete workflow from the project root:

python Run_OCVRC.py

On completion, the SQLite database is at output/final/OCVRC.db; five final pandas tables are also saved to output/final/*.pkl. Run python validation/Run_Validation.py to validate existing outputs without contacting astronomical services.

External dependencies: SIMBAD, NRAO VLASS quicklook services, CSIRO CASDA, survey catalog services and their authentication/access rules can change or be unavailable. The sample data are not a scientifically representative sample.

docs.title: Input catalog
docs.text:
The default input is input/sources.csv, specified by [PATHS] INPUT_CSV in config.txt. The ingestion code also supports Excel files when [PATHS] INPUT_FILE points to one.

Column Required Meaning RA Yes Right ascension in decimal degrees, [0,360) DEC Yes Declination in decimal degrees, [-90,90] SOURCE_ID No Unique input source identifier; generated sequentially if absent NAME No User-preferred source name CLASS No User-preferred source classification PORB No Orbital period in hours PORB_ERROR No Orbital-period error, in hours PORB_CONFIRMED No Optional confirmed flag PSPIN No Spin period in seconds PSPIN_ERROR No Spin-period error, in seconds PSPIN_CONFIRMED No Optional confirmed flag

A user-provided name or class takes precedence over SIMBAD as the default; SIMBAD alternatives are retained as additional name/class rows. Sources without a name get an automatically generated User_name_{SOURCE_ID} when necessary. Periods come from user input, not SIMBAD.

An unavailable SIMBAD service is not treated as a negative SIMBAD match. Successfully completed results may be reused according to the ingestion cache and verified-output checks.

docs.title: Limitations and release notes
docs.text:
This repository implements a source-list-to-database pipeline; it does not distribute the original complete OCVRC master-catalog research workspace. Survey completeness depends on sky coverage, processing flags and service availability. A positive fitted flux alone is not a validated astronomical detection.

The 2026-10-23 six-source test completed all pipeline stages and produced a validated 82-row measurement table. SIMBAD source-ingestion outputs were reused from an earlier successful run; thus that test did not exercise a fresh live SIMBAD query or an initial empty-cache build.

Before public release, verify a fresh-input run, package dependencies on a clean environment and determine the project's licensing terms. The publicly hosted older MkDocs site may contain additional historical explanatory text not supplied in this archive.

docs.title: Radio measurements
docs.text:
VLASS (2–4 GHz) and ASKAP RACS (887.5 MHz) survey images are sampled at catalog positions. The pipeline applies neighbor-detection logic and generalized least-squares (GLS) PSF fitting using precomputed spatial-correlation calibrations in calibration/.

The final measurement_table retains measurements even when fitted flux is negative or the neighbor flag is 1. The NEIGHBOR flag indicates a possible nearby-source contribution; it is not a detection significance indicator. Interpret flux using its uncertainty and image context.

Repeated source/epoch VLASS entries can reflect overlapping tiles. Use the actual measurement rows, not a presumed single row per epoch. See Catalog Fields.

docs.title: Additional surveys
docs.text:
The pipeline queries Gaia DR3, 2MASS, GALEX, LoTSS DR2, ROSAT, XMM-Newton, Chandra CSC 2.1 and eROSITA. Each integration populates the shared measurement_table format using survey-specific OBSERVATORY, EPOCH, BAND and UNITS. Gaia also supplies adopted distances and proper motions for source_table.

Survey matching radii and retry settings are defined independently in config.txt. The query manager stores status and checkpoint files under output/, permitting the pipeline to distinguish true NO_MATCH results from interrupted or unavailable-service queries.

A NO_MATCH does not prove an intrinsic non-detection or absence from the sky: footprints, catalog selection criteria, sensitivity and release coverage matter.

docs.title: Validation
docs.text:
The master pipeline can run the combined suite automatically with [PIPELINE] VALIDATION = TRUE or you can execute:

python validation/Run_Validation.py

Four independent checks test (1) SQLite/database structure and integrity, (2) astrometry and ingestion consistency, (3) measurement schemas and uncertainties and (4) query statuses and cached survey output consistency. The validator is read-only and performs no network queries.

The October 23, 2026 six-source integration test reported 292 PASS, 2 WARNING, 0 FAIL. Both warnings describe the same four groups of overlapping VLASS source/epoch measurements. These are example-test results, not a guarantee that arbitrary input catalogs will pass.
